title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to MrBeast?
description: Seven real photos connect Adolf Hitler to MrBeast, through Mussolini, Turkey's wartime leader, Churchill, the Queen, Trump and Ronaldo.
hook: How is Adolf Hitler connected to MrBeast?
fun_fact: Churchill spent 1943 trying to drag Turkey into the war against Hitler. Turkey held out and only declared war in February 1945.
research_note: Nearly every free photo of Mussolini shows people who died in the 1940s, so the way out to today runs through the Turkish leader he welcomed to Rome in 1932, who lived until 1973 and sat beside Churchill in Cairo.

links.line: In 1940, Hitler rode through Munich with his ally Mussolini, the dictator of Italy.

image.file: File:Ismet pacha, ministre des affaires étrangères de Turquie, Mussolini, Ruscdy Bey - btv1b9051855q.jpg

links.line: In 1932, Mussolini welcomed Turkey's prime minister to Rome.

image.file: File:Roosevelt Inönü and Churchill in Cairo cph.3b15312.jpg

links.line: By 1943 he led Turkey, and Winston Churchill sat beside him in Cairo, begging Turkey to join the war.
In 1953, Churchill was prime minister to the young Queen Elizabeth.

image.file: File:The Trumps with Elizabeth II in 2018.jpg

links.line: In 2018, the Queen welcomed Donald Trump to Windsor Castle.

links.line: In 2025, Trump had Cristiano Ronaldo in the Oval Office.
